tools.purpose: Used to combine all the ingredients together

tools.name: Knife
tools.purpose: Used for chopping vegetables and eggs

tools.name: Grater
tools.purpose: Used for grating the carrot

steps.title: Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instruction: In a bowl, add 30g of puffed rice and 15g of roasted peanuts.

steps.title: Add Vegetables
steps.instruction: Add 1 small grated carrot, 80g of baby corn, 1 chopped small onion, and 1 chopped tomato into the bowl.

steps.title: Add Chutneys and Spices
steps.instruction: Add 1 tbsp of tamarind chutney, 1 tbsp of mint chutney, a handful of fresh coriander, 1 tsp of cumin powder, 1 tbsp of chaat masala, 1 tsp of pepper, 1 tsp of salt, and 1 tsp of chilli powder.

steps.title: Add Lime and Protein
steps.instruction: Squeeze half a lime (10ml) and add 2 finely chopped hard-boiled eggs to the mixture.

steps.title: Mix and Serve
steps.instruction: Mix everything well together until thoroughly combined and serve immediately.

tips: Prepare and chop all your vegetables beforehand to ensure the puffed rice doesn't get soggy while assembling.
Adjust the spice levels with chilli powder and chaat masala to suit your taste preference.

recipe.description: This Charred Corn & Paneer Salad features golden seared paneer, charred sweet corn, crunchy veggies, and a creamy coriander cashew yogurt dressing. Finished with olive oil and chilli flakes, it is a fresh, flavorful, and exciting salad perfect for lunch or dinner.

tools.name: skillet or pan

tools.name: blender or food processor
tools.purpose: to make the creamy coriander cashew yogurt dressing

tools.name: mixing bowl
tools.purpose: to toss and combine all the salad ingredients

tools.name: knife and cutting board
tools.purpose: to chop vegetables and cube the paneer

steps.title: Char the corn
steps.instruction: Cook the sweet corn in a hot pan without much oil until nicely charred and slightly smoky.

steps.title: Sear the paneer
steps.instruction: Cube the paneer and sear it in a pan until golden brown and crispy on the edges.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.instruction: Blend yogurt, soaked cashews, and fresh coriander together until smooth and creamy.

steps.title: Assemble the salad
steps.instruction: In a large mixing bowl, combine the crunchy vegetables, charred corn, and seared paneer. Toss with the creamy coriander cashew yogurt dressing, finish with olive oil and chilli flakes, and serve.

tips: Make sure the pan is very hot before charring the corn to get that smoky flavor.
Soak the cashews in warm water beforehand for a smoother dressing texture.

recipe.description: A creamy, thick, and high protein mint cheese spread made by blending low-fat paneer with fresh herbs, garlic, and lime. Perfect as a healthy spread or dip that requires no cooking besides roasting the garlic.

tools.name: blender
tools.purpose: to blend all the ingredients until smooth and creamy

tools.name: container
tools.purpose: to store the spread in the refrigerator

steps.title: Combine Ingredients
steps.instruction: Add low fat paneer, fresh coriander, fresh mint, green chilli, roasted garlic cloves, lime juice, salt, and water to a blender.

steps.title: Blend
steps.instruction: Blend everything until the mixture is smooth and creamy.

steps.title: Chill and Serve
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a container and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

tips: Roasting the garlic beforehand adds a depth of flavor to the spread.

recipe.recipe_name: High-Protein Moong Dal and Rice Meal
recipe.description: A simple, tasty, and protein-rich healthy meal made with green moong dal, rice, and soy chunks. It easily fits into a calorie-controlled diet and can be customized with paneer and curd.

tools.name: Pressure cooker or pot
tools.purpose: To cook the moong dal, rice, and soy chunks mixture

tools.name: Knife and cutting board
tools.purpose: To chop vegetables like carrot, tomato, green chilli, and garlic

tools.name: Pan
tools.purpose: For tempering with ghee and jeera

steps.title: Prep ingredients
steps.instruction: Measure out the green moong dal, rice, and soy chunks. Wash them thoroughly. Chop the carrot, tomato, green chilli, and garlic.

steps.title: Cook the base
steps.instruction: Combine the washed green moong dal, rice, soy chunks, and chopped vegetables in a pressure cooker or pot with adequate water and cook until soft and tender.

steps.title: Add tempering
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tsp of ghee in a small pan, add jeera and garlic, let it splutter, and pour it over the cooked dal and rice mixture.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Serve hot, optionally topping with low-fat paneer and serving with a side of curd.

tips: Omit paneer and curd to keep the meal around 400 calories.
Soak soy chunks in warm water beforehand if needed for better texture.

recipe.description: A healthy and high-protein vegetarian sandwich made with a creamy blended paneer and Greek yogurt sauce, mixed with fresh vegetables, and toasted to crispy perfection. Each sandwich packs 16g of protein for only 260 calories.

tools.name: Blender
tools.purpose: To blend the paneer, yogurt, and spices into a smooth and creamy sauce

tools.name: Mixing bowl
tools.purpose: To combine the chopped vegetables with the paneer sauce

tools.name: Pan or skillet
tools.purpose: To toast the sandwich until golden and crispy

steps.title: Make the paneer sauce
steps.instruction: To a blender add low-fat paneer, garlic cloves, Greek yogurt, chilli flakes, dried red chillies, lemon juice, and salt. Blend until smooth and creamy, then set it aside.

steps.title: Prepare the vegetable filling
steps.instruction: In a bowl, add chopped onions, grated carrots, grated cucumber, and chopped coriander leaves. Pour in the blended paneer sauce and mix everything together.

steps.title: Assemble the sandwich
steps.instruction: Take 2 slices of multigrain bread, spread half of the creamy paneer filling onto the bread, and close the sandwich.

steps.title: Toast the sandwich
steps.instruction: Toast the sandwich in a pan with butter until golden and crispy on both sides.

tips: Use low-fat paneer and Greek yogurt to keep the calorie count low while maintaining high protein.
Make sure to blend the paneer mixture thoroughly until completely smooth for the best texture.

recipe.description: Skip the store-bought spreads and make this creamy, protein-packed version at home! It is smooth, flavourful, budget-friendly, and perfect for sandwiches, wraps, crackers, or as a delicious dip.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for citric acid and baking soda mixture

tools.name: pot or pan
tools.purpose: To heat the milk

tools.name: strainer
tools.purpose: To strain the cheese curds

tools.name: mixer / blender
tools.purpose: To blend the curds and seasonings into a smooth spread

tools.name: container
tools.purpose: To store and set the cheese spread in the refrigerator

steps.title: Heat the milk
steps.instruction: Heat 1 litre toned milk with 1 whole dry red chilli until the milk just starts getting hot.

steps.title: Curdle and strain
steps.instruction: Add 2 tbsp vinegar mixed with 2 tbsp water to curdle the milk, then strain the curds.

steps.title: Initial blend
steps.instruction: Transfer the curds and the red chilli to a mixer. Add a mixture of 1/4 tsp citric acid + 1/4 tsp baking soda + 2 tbsp water and blend until smooth.

steps.title: Season and set
steps.instruction: Add salt, chilli flakes, oregano, and chopped jalapeños. Blend once more, transfer to a container, and refrigerate for 4–5 hours until set.

tips: Refrigerate for 4-5 hours to let the cheese spread properly set.
Great for sandwiches, wraps, crackers, or as a dip.

recipe.description: A wholesome and delicious homemade bread made using semolina (suji) and instant yeast. It features a soft texture, golden crust, and can be easily baked in an oven or pressure cooker.

tools.name: Mixing bowl
tools.purpose: To combine the dry and wet ingredients for the dough

tools.name: Loaf pan
tools.purpose: To shape and bake the bread loaf

tools.name: Oven
tools.purpose: To bake the bread at 180°C

tools.name: Pastry brush
tools.purpose: To brush milk on top of the dough before baking

steps.title: Mix Dry Ingredients
steps.instruction: To a bowl, add 1½ cups suji, 1 tbsp caster sugar, 1 tsp instant yeast, and ¼ tsp salt. Mix well.

steps.title: Add Wet Ingredients and Rest
steps.instruction: Add ½ cup water, 3 tbsp milk, and 2 tbsp oil. Mix everything well and let it rest for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Knead the Dough
steps.instruction: Transfer the dough onto a greased surface and knead well for 15 minutes.

steps.title: First Proof
steps.instruction: Cover and let the dough proof for 1 hour, or until it doubles in size.

steps.title: Shape the Loaf
steps.instruction: Once doubled, punch it down, roll it out, and shape it into a log. Make sure to pinch and seal the dough after every roll.

steps.title: Second Proof
steps.instruction: Transfer it into a greased loaf pan, cover, and let it rise again for about 2–3 hours.

steps.title: Bake the Bread
steps.instruction: Brush the top with milk, sprinkle with seeds of your choice, and bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

steps.title: Cool and Slice
steps.instruction: Let the bread cool completely, slice it up, and your homemade Suji Bread is ready!

tips: Make sure to pinch and seal the dough tightly after every roll when shaping the log.
You can use a pressure cooker instead of an oven if preferred.
Ensure the yeast is fresh for a proper rise.

recipe.description: An extremely healthy, protein-packed tandoori soya recipe made easily in the airfryer. Soya chunks and vegetables are marinated in a spiced hung yogurt mixture and air-fried to perfection.

tools.name: Airfryer
tools.purpose: To cook the marinated soya chunks and vegetables

tools.name: Mixing bowl
tools.purpose: To combine and marinate the soya chunks and vegetables with the yogurt and spices

tools.name: Knife and cutting board
tools.purpose: To cube the onions and bell peppers

steps.title: Prepare Soya Chunks
steps.instruction: Soak the soya chunks in water until soft, then drain completely.

steps.title: Make the Marinade
steps.instruction: In a mixing bowl, combine hung yogurt, besan atta, mustard oil, ginger garlic paste, salt, turmeric, red chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, kasuri methi, and tandoori masala. Mix well.

steps.title: Coat Soya and Vegetables
steps.instruction: Add the drained soya chunks, cubed onions, and cubed bell peppers into the marinade. Toss well to coat everything evenly.

steps.title: Air Fry
steps.instruction: Transfer the coated mixture into the airfryer and cook until charred and cooked through.

steps.title: Garnish and Serve
steps.instruction: Finish with a squeeze of lime/lemon juice, a sprinkle of chaat masala, and brush with butter on top.

tips: Make sure to thoroughly drain the water from the soya chunks so they absorb the marinade better.
Using mustard oil gives this dish an authentic tandoori flavor.
Brushing butter on top at the end enhances the taste significantly.

recipe.description: A healthy, air-fried homemade makhana trail mix that serves as a great alternative to store-bought namkeen. No deep frying is needed for this light and crunchy snack.

tools.name: Air fryer
tools.purpose: To roast the makhana without deep frying

tools.name: Mixing bowl
tools.purpose: To toss the makhana with oil and spices

steps.instruction: Place the makhana in a mixing bowl and add ghee or oil along with the spices, tossing well to coat evenly.

steps.title: Air Fry
steps.instruction: Transfer the coated makhana into the air fryer basket and air fry until crispy.

tips: Do not deep fry to keep it healthy.
Adjust spices according to your taste preference.

recipe.description: Crispy, spicy, and incredibly easy crunchy paneer snacks made entirely in the air fryer. The thinner you slice the paneer, the crispier your chips will become.

tools.name: Air Fryer
tools.purpose: To cook and crisp the paneer chips

tools.name: Knife
tools.purpose: To slice the paneer very thinly

tools.name: Basting brush
tools.purpose: To lightly brush oil on the paneer

steps.title: Slice the Paneer
steps.instruction: Slice the paneer into very thin pieces.

steps.title: Arrange in Air Fryer
steps.instruction: Arrange the paneer pieces in a single layer inside the air fryer basket.

steps.title: Oil and Season
steps.instruction: Brush lightly with oil, then sprinkle salt, garlic powder, red chilli powder, and black pepper powder evenly over the paneer.

steps.title: Air Fry
steps.instruction: Air fry at 170°C for 9 minutes, or until golden and crispy. Flip the paneer halfway through to prevent burning.

steps.title: Cool and Serve
steps.instruction: Let them cool for 1-2 minutes so they can get even crispier as they cool.

Make sure to flip the paneer halfway through cooking so it does not burn.

recipe.recipe_name: Air Fryer Peanut Butter Banana Muffins
recipe.description: These healthy air fryer peanut butter banana muffins are made with wholesome oat flour and a surprise gooey frozen peanut butter center. Topped with chopped bananas and cranberries, they make for a delicious and easy guilt-free treat.

ingredients.note: plus extra ½ tsp frozen for filling

tools.purpose: Used for baking the muffins

tools.purpose: To hold the muffin batter during baking

tools.name: Mixing bowl
tools.purpose: To mash banana and mix all ingredients

steps.title: Mash Banana
steps.instruction: Mash the ripe banana well in a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Mix Ingredients
steps.instruction: Add egg, oats flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, peanut butter, milk, cocoa powder, and vanilla essence. Beat everything well until smooth.

steps.title: Layer Muffin Moulds
steps.instruction: Fill each muffin mould with a layer of the prepared batter.

steps.title: Add Peanut Butter Core
steps.instruction: Add about ½ tsp of frozen peanut butter in the centre of each mould, then cover with another layer of muffin batter.

steps.title: Top Muffins
steps.instruction: Top the batter with a little chopped banana and cranberries.

steps.title: Bake in Air Fryer
steps.instruction: Preheat the air fryer to 165–170°C. Place a small bowl of water inside the air fryer while baking to prevent the top from browning too quickly and keep the muffins soft. Air fry until baked through and a toothpick inserted comes out clean.

tips: Keep the peanut butter frozen before adding it to the centre so it stays nicely gooey inside.
Place a small bowl of water inside the air fryer while baking to prevent the top from browning too quickly and keep the muffins soft.

recipe.description: A quick and delicious personal pizza made using slices of bread as the base, loaded with sauce, cheese, and your favorite toppings, then cooked to crispy perfection in the air fryer in just 10 minutes total.

tools.purpose: To bake and crisp the bread pizza

tools.name: Knife
tools.purpose: To chop vegetables

tools.name: Spoon
tools.purpose: To spread the pizza sauce

steps.title: Prep the base
steps.instruction: Arrange the bread slices on a clean surface or cutting board.

steps.title: Add sauce
steps.instruction: Spread an even layer of pizza sauce over each slice of bread.

steps.title: Add cheese and toppings
steps.instruction: Top the sauce with a layer of shredded mozzarella cheese, followed by diced onions, bell peppers, and sweet corn.

steps.title: Season
steps.instruction: Sprinkle mixed herbs and chili flakes on top of the loaded pizzas.

steps.title: Air fry
steps.instruction: Place the prepared bread pizzas into the air fryer basket and cook at 180°C (350°F) for about 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

tips: Preheat your air fryer for an extra crispy crust.
Do not overcrowd the air fryer basket; cook in batches if necessary.

recipe.description: Crispy, crunchy, and addictive KFC-style paneer popcorn made healthier in the air fryer. Bite-sized paneer cubes are marinated in spices, coated in seasoned corn flour and water, and rolled in crushed cornflakes before being air-fried to golden perfection.

tools.name: Bowl
tools.purpose: For holding corn flour and mixing ingredients

tools.name: Knife
tools.purpose: For cutting the paneer into cubes

steps.title: Cut Paneer
steps.instruction: Cut the paneer into small bite-sized cubes.

steps.title: Marinate Paneer
steps.instruction: Add paneer, ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala, salt, and lemon juice. Mix well and let it marinate.

steps.title: Prepare Coating Stations
steps.instruction: Take corn flour in a bowl and season it with some salt. Crush the cornflakes into small pieces and keep them ready for coating.

steps.title: Coat Paneer

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Serve hot with your favourite dip and enjoy!

recipe.description: A popular Indian appetizer made by marinating cubes of paneer and vegetables in a spiced yogurt mixture, then air-frying until charred and smoky. This healthier version achieves restaurant-style results with minimal oil.

tools.name: mixing bowl
tools.purpose: to prepare the marinade and mix the paneer and vegetables

tools.name: whisk
tools.purpose: to combine the yogurt and spices smoothly

tools.name: air fryer
tools.purpose: to cook the paneer tikka without deep frying

steps.title: Prepare the Marinade
steps.instruction: In a mixing bowl, combine thick yogurt, ginger garlic paste, kashmiri red chili powder, garam masala, turmeric, coriander powder, chaat masala, lemon juice, mustard oil, and salt. Whisk well until smooth.

steps.title: Marinate Paneer and Veggies
steps.instruction: Add the paneer cubes, bell pepper, and onion petals into the marinade. Gently toss to coat everything evenly. Let it rest for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Preheat Air Fryer
steps.instruction: Preheat your air fryer to 200°C (400°F) for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Air Fry
steps.instruction: Place the marinated paneer and vegetables in the air fryer basket in a single layer. Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through until slightly charred.

tips: Use hung curd or thick Greek yogurt so the marinade doesn't become watery.
Adding a spoonful of hot mustard oil enhances the traditional tandoori flavor.
Do not overcrowd the air fryer basket for even cooking and charring.

recipe.description: A soft and fluffy whole wheat Pullman bread made using the Tangzhong method and baked to perfection in an air fryer. It features a tender crumb, a neat square shape, and requires resting before slicing for the best texture.

tools.name: Pullman Bread Tin
tools.purpose: 4x4x8 inch tin to shape and bake the bread

tools.name: Pan
tools.purpose: To cook the tangzhong paste on low heat

tools.name: Air Fryer
tools.purpose: To bake the bread

steps.title: Make Tangzhong
steps.instruction: Cook 25 g maida and 125 g water on low heat until it becomes a thick paste. Cool completely.

steps.title: Initial Dough Mixing
steps.instruction: Combine wheat flour, yeast, sugar, salt, honey, prepared tangzhong, and milk. Knead for 5-6 minutes.

steps.title: Add Butter and Knead
steps.instruction: Add butter and knead until the dough becomes smooth and elastic (8-10 minutes).

steps.title: First Rise
steps.instruction: Cover and let the dough rise for 90 minutes.

steps.title: Shape and Proof
steps.instruction: Shape into a tight log and place in a greased 4x4x8 inch Pullman tin. Proof until dough reaches about 1 cm below the rim, then close the lid.

steps.title: Bake in Air Fryer
steps.instruction: Preheat air fryer at 200°C for 5 minutes. Bake at 170°C for 12 minutes. Turn the tin upside down and bake at 170°C for another 12 minutes. Turn the tin sideways and bake again at 170°C for 12 minutes.

steps.title: Cooling and Resting
steps.instruction: Remove bread from the tin after 10 to 15 minutes, cover with a clean cloth and cool completely. Put it back into the Pullman tin, close the lid, and rest for 10-12 hours before slicing.

tips: Choose Pullman bread tin according to your airfryer pot size.
Make sure the tangzhong cools completely before adding it to the dough.
Do not skip the 10-12 hours rest time before slicing for the best texture.

recipe.description: A healthier, air-fried twist on viral burger bombs packed with protein and flavor. These bite-sized treats deliver all the satisfaction of a classic cheeseburger without the heavy guilt.

steps.title: Prepare the meat mixture

steps.title: Form the bombs

steps.title: Wrap in dough
steps.instruction: Flatten out pieces of your dough, place a meat-and-cheese ball inside each, and pinch the edges to seal completely.

steps.title: Air fry

Serve with your favorite healthy burger sauce or mustard.

recipe.description: A healthier, guilt-free homemade version of the classic market-style crunchy moong dal namkeen. Made easily using an air fryer without deep frying, it is the perfect crispy evening tea-time snack.

ingredients.note: soaked in water for 3-4 hours and drained

tools.name: Strainer
tools.purpose: To thoroughly drain the soaked moong dal

steps.title: Soak the Dal
steps.instruction: Wash and soak the yellow moong dal in water for 3 to 4 hours.

steps.title: Drain and Dry
steps.instruction: Drain all the water completely using a strainer and pat the dal dry with a clean kitchen towel to remove excess moisture.

steps.title: Preheat and Toss
steps.instruction: Preheat your air fryer. Toss the dried moong dal with a teaspoon of oil to ensure an even crunch.

steps.title: Season and Serve
steps.instruction: Remove the crispy moong dal from the air fryer, toss it with salt, red chili powder, and chaat masala while still warm, then let it cool before storing.

tips: Make sure the dal is completely dry before air frying to get that market-style crispiness.
Shake the air fryer basket periodically during cooking for even roasting.
Store in an airtight container once cooled completely.

recipe.description: Delicious and healthy vegetarian kebabs made with protein-packed soya chunks, flattened rice, and a fragrant blend of roasted besan and spices. Perfectly spiced and pan-roasted for a delightful snack.

tools.name: Pot
tools.purpose: for boiling the soya chunks

tools.name: Pan
tools.purpose: for roasting the besan and spices

steps.title: Boil Soya Chunks
steps.instruction: Boil 1 liter of water with 1 tsp of salt, add 150 gms of soya chunks, cook until soft, and then squeeze out all excess water.

steps.title: Roast Besan & Spices
steps.instruction: Heat 3 tsp of desi ghee in a pan, add 1/2 cup besan, 1 tsp Kashmiri red chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin seeds, and 1 tsp coriander seeds. Roast until aromatic.

steps.title: Prepare Kebab Mixture
steps.instruction: Grind the boiled soya chunks with onions, coriander leaves, ginger, green chillies, garlic cloves, 1/2 cup poha, and dried red chillies. Transfer to a bowl and mix with roasted besan, salt, red chilli powder, coriander powder, chat masala, garam masala, and roasted jeera powder.

steps.title: Shape and Cook Kebabs
steps.instruction: Shape the mixture into kebabs and pan-roast them on a tawa with a little oil or ghee until golden brown and crispy on both sides.

steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture into the air fryer basket. Cook at 180°C for 5 to 7 minutes.

steps.title: Add Extra Crunch
steps.instruction: Give the rice a good mix, then cook for an additional 2 minutes to achieve the ultimate crunchy veggie texture.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Serve garam-garam (hot) and enjoy your crispy Schezwan fried rice.

tips: Use day-old cold leftover rice for the best texture and to prevent it from getting mushy.
Do not overcrowd the air fryer basket so the rice gets evenly crispy.
